name: Crystal Clear Electronic Material Co.,Ltd
summary: Crystal Clear Electronic Material Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and manufacture of high-purity chemicals, lithium battery materials, photoresists, industrial chemicals, and energy in China and internationally. The company was formerly known as Suzhou Crystal Clear Chemical Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Crystal Clear Electronic Material Co., Ltd. in August 2021. Crystal Clear Electronic Material Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
